post.text:
🚨 SHERIFF CONFIRMS: "YOU WILL NEVER BE ARRESTED FOR MISSING JURY DUTY"

Sheriff Javier Salazar goes on camera and puts one of America’s biggest quiet fears to rest.

Miss jury duty? The worst thing that happens is you get a LETTER saying you missed it.
There is NO warrant. NO https://t.co/faSWXOGK2h

tweetMedia.transcription: I need everybody to stop falling for the jury duty scam. If you miss jury duty, the most you're going to get is a letter saying you missed jury duty. You're never going to get a warrant for your arrest. We're never going to call you saying you have a warrant for your arrest. You're never going to get a call asking you to pay a fine through Bitcoin from a convenience store or Apple gift cards. We're never going to call you asking you for personal identifying information or credit card information by phone. and we're never going to call you asking you to make a large cash withdrawal to give to some Uber driver or to meet us in person. Things that never happened. Stop calling for scams.

botInput.comments:
- @f_pitt2000 (Hans Gruber the Great): I want to be on a jury.  I’ve never been asked or picked.  I’m quite eager to find someone guilty.  
  Engagement: Likes=137

- @Ultrahog96 (W D): In GA if you miss jury duty, at the order of the judge, a deputy will come get you, haul you in and you will have opportunity to explain. The judge can dismiss you, fine you in contempt, or jail you. If you truly can't make it, you best act on it before your show date!  
  Engagement: Likes=117

- @SSB_Rick (CMAC): False. I missed it in Iowa and had a warrant for my arrest. Maybe put the area in your post.  
  Engagement: Likes=98

- @BrandonHuston15 (Brandon H): I’ve had jury duty three times. I’ve gotten out of jury duty three times. Here’s the trick… Get there on time. By that I mean 15 minutes early. Stay in your car in the parking lot. Call the courthouse and tell them you’ll be 10 to 20 minutes late due to traffic. 99.99% of the time, the clerk who answers says you can’t be late, that the judge won’t let you in if you’re late. Act nervous and worried about going to jail, and they’ll usually say, “Don’t worry about it, just be prepared for the next roll call because you’ll be selected.” That next roll call/selection is usually three or four years later. You’re welcome. Just make sure you’re in the parking lot in case you get the one judge who doesn’t mind late arrivals. They may say you can show up late, but don’t show up late. Just go ahead and go inside if the Clerk doesn’t excuse you.  
  Engagement: Likes=81

- @de_fluffy_panda (Fluffy Panda): False. You have 15 seconds to comply.  
  Engagement: Likes=28

- @HelvidiusPrisc (Helvidius Priscus ⚖️ 🦈): The dozen people I watched be tried for contempt for missing jury duty all beg to differ with this sheriff.  
  Engagement: Likes=21

- @idiocracy310 (Digger310): I’ve always answered the call for jury duty over the course of my adult life, but I recently found out that family member has ignored jury duty summonses his entire life. He said he’s never heard a thing from the court. I was blown away. I can verify that this is correct  
  Engagement: Likes=19

- @glennthegreat (G. BARR): This definitely depends on the jurisdiction. It is rare to be held in contempt, but certainly not impossible. He’s right that you don’t need to redeem gift cards, pay fines in crypto or any of that scam nonsense.  
  Engagement: Likes=18

- @Gooie2021 (⚜️ MLCVE ⚜️): Well here in Louisiana you do get a bench warrant and you do get picked up and face the judge if he calls your name and you aren’t there.  Saw it happen first hand several times.  
  Engagement: Likes=18

- @Chris_LaPenta (Cleaner Tesla): Everyone knew this right? I mean, how can they ever prove you received the letter? They send them first class mail. I never in 40 years responded  
  Engagement: Likes=15
